title: Jesús de Miguel (CD Tenerife, 1996–2026)
post: Jesús de Miguel, 1996–2026. Tenerife's number 9 died after a collision in added time against Andorra. Rest in peace. #football #tenerife #jesusdemiguel #laliga

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; a quiet, steady read (a tribute, not a hype short)

phrases.text: Added time. A ball bouncing toward midfield. Jesús de Miguel went for it, and never got up.
phrases.say: [somber] Added time... A ball bouncing toward midfield. Jesús de Miguel went for it... [softly] and never got up.

phrases.text: He was thirty. A striker from Madrid who climbed through Spain's lower leagues and only turned pro at twenty-seven.
phrases.say: He was thirty. A striker from Madrid... who climbed through Spain's lower leagues, and only turned pro at twenty-seven.

phrases.text: Last season, his eleven goals helped Tenerife back into the second division.
phrases.say: Last season, his eleven goals helped Tenerife back into the second division.

phrases.text: Monday, November second. Tenerife against Andorra. 2–2, deep in added time.
phrases.say: Monday, November second. Tenerife against Andorra... two all, deep in added time.

phrases.text: A clearance bounced toward midfield. He chased it. Andorra's goalkeeper, Jesús Owono, came out for it too.
phrases.say: A clearance bounced toward midfield. He chased it... Andorra's goalkeeper, Jesús Owono, came out for it too.

phrases.text: The keeper's knee caught him in the chest. His heart stopped.
phrases.say: [quietly] The keeper's knee caught him in the chest... His heart stopped.

phrases.text: Players screamed for the medics. He was carried off, and his pulse came back in the ambulance.
phrases.say: Players screamed for the medics. He was carried off... and his pulse came back in the ambulance.

phrases.text: He died in hospital the next morning, at eight. A preliminary autopsy points to the blow to his chest.
phrases.say: [sad] He died in hospital the next morning, at eight... A preliminary autopsy points to the blow to his chest.

phrases.text: Owono had run to him with the others. The next day he wrote: these are the hardest days of my life.
phrases.say: Owono had run to him with the others. The next day he wrote... [softly] these are the hardest days of my life.

phrases.text: That weekend, matches across Spain stopped in the ninth minute. His number.
phrases.say: That weekend, matches across Spain stopped in the ninth minute... His number.
